decisions.executionNote: Raise left arm into elbow-up approach and begin aligning to the left tube; right arm stays home.
Advance above the left tube, progressively turning the gripper downward and matching its diagonal axis.
Finish overhead alignment with the left tube, stopping above grasp height for visual refinement.
Lower toward the tube body with a small capward and lateral correction, keeping jaws open.
Close on the aligned left tube, then lift slightly to check retention visually.
Tube appears retained. Lift clear and begin rotating it upright while retracting safely.
Carry the retained tube toward the left rack slots while continuing a smooth upright rotation.
Finish upright orientation over a left-side rack opening, staying above the rack for alignment.
Approach the left-front opening slowly; refine placement from the wrist view before insertion.
Lower the upright tube toward insertion depth with small vertical steps and no lateral sweep.
Tube appears to contact a rim. Lift to relieve contact and shift slightly toward the opening before retrying.
Retry a controlled vertical insertion at the corrected alignment, watching for further rim contact.
Open to let the upright tube settle into the opening, then withdraw for an unobstructed placement check.
The released tube tilted rather than seating. Clear the rack and inspect its settled position before recovery.
Clear the left arm for a full scene check while starting an elbow-up approach to the front right tube.
Return the left arm away from the fallen tube; advance the right gripper above the front tube with a downward approach.
Bring the right gripper over the front tube and finish most of its downward rotation; left arm returns near origin.
Finish the right downward alignment and lower to the tube body with open jaws.
Grasp the front right tube and lift clear to verify retention.
Tube is retained. Lift and retract while starting a smooth upright rotation for right-side placement.
Carry the right-held tube over the right rack area, continuing the upright rotation with clearance.
Finish bringing the retained tube upright above the rightmost large opening; inspect before descending.
Descend toward the right-front large opening while correcting the last small tube tilt.
Lower in small vertical increments toward seating; monitor the tube against the rack rim.
Rim contact is visible from tube slip. Lift free and shift slightly backward and inward toward the large opening.
Retry vertical entry at the corrected right-side alignment without releasing the tube.
The tube followed the last descent. Continue a short, slow insertion and check for seating or renewed slip.
The tip is still on the web beside the large hole. Lift and make a small outward correction before another insertion.
The large opening is now beneath the tube. Lower slowly while retaining it.
Tube continues to follow the gripper over the large opening. Continue the slow insertion to compensate for earlier slip.
Stop at rack contact, release above the aligned large opening, and withdraw gently to check settling.
The released tube is upright in the rack. Withdraw clear and begin an overhead approach to the remaining right tube.
Replan from the interrupted pose with smaller increments, moving above the remaining right tube and turning the gripper downward.
Continue above the remaining right tube, progressively matching its diagonal axis while maintaining elbow-up continuity.
Complete the downward grasp orientation over the remaining tube, stopping above contact to refine its position.
Wrist view shows the tube offset and angled. Shift outward and reduce yaw to align the jaws with its actual axis.
Refine the right tube alignment and lower the open jaws to grasp height.
Make a final small centering and yaw correction, then close on the tube body.
Lift the newly grasped right tube clear of the table and retract before carrying it upright toward an empty central slot.
Carry the retained tube inward above the rack, keeping height clear of the already inserted tube while rotating upright.
Move the tube toward an empty central opening above the rack, finishing most of the upright rotation.
Align the upright tube over the empty middle large slot, then approach its rim while keeping the neighboring tube clear.
Lower the upright tube vertically into the middle large opening, maintaining grip and checking for rim contact.
Finish a short slow seating motion for the middle tube; check stability before opening.
Release the middle tube at seating depth and withdraw gently to inspect whether it remains upright in the rack.
Two tubes appear upright in the rack. Clear the right arm and begin an elbow-up left approach to recover the remaining tube.
Advance the left arm above the fallen tube with an aligned downward approach; return the clear right arm toward home.
Finish aligning above the recovered tube while bringing the right arm back near origin; keep both motions continuous.
Use smaller increments after the guard interruption; finish left-tube alignment and gently return the right arm near home.
Center the left jaws nearer the recovered tube's cap and lower to grasp height; settle the right arm at origin.
Close on the recovered left tube and lift slightly to confirm retention before returning to the rack.
